responses.analysis: My revised prompt used a short decision table based on the robot’s current coordinates. However, the model repeatedly chose UP, hit the upper wall, moved DOWN, and returned UP. It never followed the instruction to turn RIGHT at row 1. The run had 35 successful moves, 15 blocked moves, no STOP actions, and ended at (1,2) without reaching the goal. The second supplied prompt made more progress, reaching (7,1). Although my route instructions were feasible, the model did not consistently apply them.
